why: Analysis 2 ties its hedgehog to outcome-defined quality at import-competitive cost, makes dropping the color crown and debt its first stop-doing item, and is more soberly calibrated (18/100, endurance unproven, margins derived from dossier figures and caveated). Analysis 1 is comparably complete and better anticipates the Stage 3 blame-shifting onto import "dumping", but its verdict is less pointed and its score more generous for a company at the edge of decline.
